reception: The piece draws light citation of its own — the research credit flows to the PLDI paper — and its reception is correspondingly modest. Where it is cited, it serves as an accessible reference for PetaBricks and for autotuning in general: SPIRAL's account of extreme performance portability lists it among autotuning systems, papers on autotuning divide-and-conquer stencils and on autotuning exascale applications do the same, and work on programming and mapping strategies for runtime-adaptable embedded computing gives it a closer reading. The pattern suits the genre — an introduction written for students, cited when authors want an approachable entry to the idea.
